courses.title: Employee Relations in Practice
courses.description: Employee Relations in Practice takes you from the basics of employee relations to applying it on a realistic HR Manager scenario, through short lessons and hands-on practice. Along the way, you'll also get a practical introduction to onboarding design, enough to use it alongside employee relations day to day. Expect a practical course, not a lecture-heavy one.
learning_outcomes: Applying employee relations to a real HR Manager scenario
Practicing employee relations through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to onboarding design
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Diversity and Inclusion Practices for Practitioners
courses.description: Diversity and Inclusion Practices for Practitioners is a focused course on diversity and inclusion practices for people already working toward a HR Manager role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying diversity and inclusion practices on your own.

alternates.title: Employee Relations Essentials
alternates.description: Employee Relations Essentials is a short introduction to employee relations for people moving toward a HR Manager role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show employee relations in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if employee relations is new to you.
